description: Designs the persistence layer of an already-modeled use case, in the storage family its use case records — relational (tables, JPA mapping, Flyway migrations, datasource) or document (MongoDB collections, embedded and referenced data, indexes and validators ensured at startup, `@Version`, transactions on a replica set) — plus the audit level its use case records (created/modified stamps, or an Envers history with actor and revision) — into the `20-persistence.md` partial. Use when the request involves modeling the database, mapping an aggregate to JPA or to a MongoDB document, writing or reviewing migrations, deciding indexes and keys, auditing who changed a record and its earlier values, diagnosing N+1 or slow queries, or tuning the pool, datasource or MongoDB client properties. Piece of the `/new-feature` pipeline: requires `00-use-case.md` with a `Storage` row and `10-domain.md` in the given folder, and stops without them.
